decisions.reason: The antenna orientation and keepout constraints do not change DCDC1 voltage regulation, load coverage, or rail-stability behavior.
The antenna clearance decision does not alter the 5V boost rail, its GPIO control, or its powered loads.
Placing the antenna away from the battery with a 3 mm keepout does not change standalone USB power behavior or source selection.
The source constrains antenna placement relative to the battery but does not change the battery voltage range, AXP2101 power path, charging behavior, or required rails.
The source does not change the charge-status display method, external charge-LED interface, or associated electrical values.
